I Like Control "I Like Control" is a song by DJ Clue? featuring Missy Elliott and her former protégées Nicole Wray and Mocha. The song was released via radio airplay on February 13, 1999 as the second single from Clue's solo debut studio album, "The Professional" (1998). The song charted on "Billboard" Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs based solely on airplay, where it debuted in its peak position of #81.
